description: This file defines a helper class 'UserRoleManagerHelper' in the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to interact with user role management, fetch permissions, and verify access based on employee number. It acts as an abstraction layer over role management functionalities.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods to retrieve and verify user role permissions, including data group permissions for entities and employees, using the UserRoleManager service.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Retrieves the UserRoleManager service from the container.

methods.name: getEntityIndependentDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Fetches data group permissions without considering any specific employee or entity.

methods.name: geEntityIndependentDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Returns a collection of data group permissions without entity context, based on provided data groups.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Gets data group permissions for a specified employee or the logged-in user if none specified.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of data group permissions for a specific employee or the logged-in user.

methods.name: isSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks if the specified employee number matches the logged-in employee's number.

methods.name: isEmployeeAccessible
methods.description: Determines if an employee's data is accessible either directly or via self-permission.
